## What this letter says
Your dating scan on 22 September 2026 showed you are 10 weeks pregnant.
The letter says your medicine, sertraline, was talked about at the appointment.
The letter also gives a booking appointment with the midwife.

## What you need to do
1. Continue taking sertraline 50 mg once a day.

## Dates and medicines
- 22 September 2026: dating scan.
- Tuesday 13 October 2026 at 10:00: booking appointment with the midwife.
- Sertraline, 50 mg, once a day. Continue taking it.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- Can you tell me more about my sertraline?
- What will happen at my booking appointment with the midwife?
- Who can I ask if I am not sure about my appointment date?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.
